test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters, that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

d _ n _ b _ d a _ t b _ d a n _ b v

options.text: a n t v v t
a t v n v t
a t v b v t
b t v n v t

solution:
Given sequence: d _ n _ b _ d a _ t b _ d a n _ b v

 
• a n t v v t → d **a** n **n** b **t -** d a **v** t b **v -** d a n **t** b v
 
• a t v n v t → d **a** n **t** b **v** - d a **n**&nb
